findings.description: The Lambda function embeds long-lived AWS credentials (access_key and secret_key) directly as plaintext environment variables. These are stored in Terraform state, visible in the AWS console/API and any configuration dump, and cannot be rotated without a redeploy, so anyone with read access to the function or its state obtains the keys.

The function is configured with runtime "nodejs12.x", a Node.js release that has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches. Continuing to run on an unsupported runtime exposes the function to publicly known unpatched vulnerabilities.
